authority.original_claims: P1 game-agnostic principle; P2 budget-quality benchmark target; P3 emergent untuned signatures; P4 CPU gate
authority.restoration_status: Separate companion research document. Original THESIS and CLAIM_LEDGER unchanged.

next_goal: Calibrate a model of observations produced by ACTUAL computation actions from correlated, adaptive search and a structurally different non-game decision task; use it to predict heldout change in terminal decision risk and compute price before proposing a shadow live controller.
theory_stages: R1 identify source/status and pose concrete prediction target
R2 recover primary metareasoning and correlated observation literature
R3 define state-conditional observation and dependency, latent belief and payoffs
R4 construct alternative likelihood/calibration models and conditional counterexamples
R5 derive predictive posterior regret and error sensitivity with computation cost
R6 independently challenge correlation, nonstationarity, missing candidates and frame changes
R7 execute exact/small numerical experiments against frozen observations
R8 admit claims only per source family and heldout calibration
R10 hand off derivations, failure cases and audited readback
coding_stages: C1 verify exact C17, original thesis and associated source/tool SHA
C2 map observation model to typed Rust/Python project interfaces without domain logic leakage
C3 cost and numerical stability/predeclared calibration tolerance
C4 freeze two distinct sources, evaluator revisions, grouped splits and denominator before training
C5 implement observation likelihood estimator and task adapter with RED/GREEN
C6 Rust integration in SHADOW mode plus independent Python semantic tests
C7 freeze matched-budget benchmarks and evaluation runner before test data unblinding
C8 run actual continued Rust MCTS and a separate non-game decision task with heldout predictions
C9 independently audit calibration, actual costs, wrong-stop rate and archive restore
C10 conclude with negative/positive results, stagewise Git push/archive hash and next handoff
admission: At least two structurally different decision domains/task families and truly independent parent-source grouped train/calibration/test
Use actual measured wall or NN cost with explicit unit and utility/resource conversion; no equal-visits-equal-time assumptions
Check heldout predictive likelihood reliability and noninferiority of terminal decision quality separately from compute savings
Controller cannot read offline oracle or human signature metrics at runtime
Remain SHADOW if observation model is uncalibrated or wrong-stop risk is unacceptable
Preserve negative evidence, no retrospective tuning to fix failures
Every R/C stage produces its own source-valid commit, exact GitHub remote SHA equality and locally sha256-checked Git tar archive; Dropbox cloud acknowledgment separate
No branch merge, deletion, extra plugin installation or PR until specifically requested
next_action: Start from clean separate worktree at final C17 branch. Prioritize real posterior observation calibration rather than adding another chess/Gomoku tactic.
